soundness_flags.label: def:extremal-family / thm:sharpness-family
soundness_flags.one_line: The purported full-data law P_h specifies X,Y_0,Y_1 but never specifies A or its allocation probability, so P_h is not yet a constructed member of the randomized law class.

soundness_flags.label: ass:wald-nondegeneracy / thm:split-wald
soundness_flags.one_line: Uniform Wald nondegeneracy over all of Theta conflicts with the stated inclusion of equality laws and the theorem's own criterion nu_S^2=0 iff b_S=0; define a separated Theta_+ subclass for Wald inference.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies covariate-aware conditional optimal transport for causal partial identification, gives a relaxation, and analyzes estimator convergence; it does not state a cardinality-budget submodularity frontier.
For regression R-squared, the submodularity ratio is lower-bounded by the smallest (k+|U|)-sparse covariance eigenvalue, yielding the forward-regression guarantee.
The paper proves a tight cardinality-constrained greedy guarantee in terms of generalized curvature and submodularity ratio for generic nondecreasing set functions.
The paper gives model-agnostic COT-based inference and multiplier-bootstrap covariate/model selection without sacrificing validity.
The paper proves adapted-Wasserstein continuity of COT and develops a direct consistent nonparametric estimator with a convergence rate.
The paper develops wavelet COT estimation under smooth densities and establishes asymptotic normality for quadratic cost.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Complete the unequal-scale witness by setting A independently Bernoulli(1/2) (or an explicit pi in (0,1)), and state the centered Gaussian construction of X and its independent residual noises as a full law.
Replace the global Wald premise by an explicitly defined separated image Theta_+={vartheta in Theta:min_{S in A}nu_S(vartheta)>=nu_*}; retain projection inference on all Theta, including equality.

Advance the fixed-budget handle to a solved exact frontier or a rigorously constructed violating family; this is the credible path from the current field theorem to a flagship-grade new causal geometric object.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two well-posedness/coherence defects, then advance the repaired field-tier angular-frontier kernel to Stage 0.
